snap.change: FY2025 SNAP benefit tables updated. Maximum allotments increased 3.0% based on Thrifty Food Plan adjustments.
snap.source: USDA FNS — October 2024 cost of living adjustment

snap.change: 2024 Federal Poverty Level thresholds updated. Gross income limit for SNAP raised from 130% to reflect new FPL baseline.

medicaid.change: Medicaid continuous enrollment unwind completed. States resumed eligibility redeterminations. Some households previously protected by continuous enrollment may now be subject to review.
2024 FPL thresholds updated. Medicaid income limits adjusted in ACA-expansion states.

wic.change: WIC food package updated. Increased fruit and vegetable cash value benefit from $24 to $26/month for most participants.
wic.source: USDA FNS — WIC food package update October 2024

tanf.change: CalWORKs maximum aid payment increased 3.6% effective January 2024.
New York Safety Net Assistance and Family Assistance grants increased 3.6% effective January 2024.

liheap.change: FY2025 LIHEAP funding allocations released. Benefit amounts vary by state and heating season demand.
liheap.source: HHS ACF — FY2025 LIHEAP block grant allocations

free_school_meals.change: SY2024-25 free and reduced-price meal income thresholds updated to reflect 2024 FPL. Free meal threshold: 130% FPL; reduced: 185% FPL.
free_school_meals.source: USDA FNS — SY2024-25 income eligibility guidelines

lifeline.change: Lifeline benefit remains at $9.25/month standard and $34.25/month on qualifying Tribal lands. No change from 2023.

ssi.change: SSI federal benefit rate increased 3.2% COLA to $943/month for individuals, $1,415/month for couples.
